text: The debt collectors, Clear Recovery Collection is supposed to call me before they withdrawal any funds from my account that was the agreement and they don't have a judgment/lawsuit against me in this debt. They took money out of my account without contacting me to confirm payment. I've been paying them every month for the last year plus. Every single time they've called and confirmed that I am authorized them to charge my account one time. Until this month I received no phone calls and no notice of a pending withdrawal from my bank account without my permission or a judges ruling. There isn't anything far as I know being filed in court for collections of this debt. I don't understand how they can garnish my checking account without a ruling from a judge to which I have not received a court order. So their legal standings to withdraw from my account, without my permission. Is as far as I've gathered reading the laws they're violating my rights for fair treatment for this debt I've been paying. Again The name of the company is Clear Recovery Collections.
